en.t: The flowers are blooming so beautifully!

units.source_text: 可能在种法上有什么秘诀吧。”

en.t: There must be some secret to the way they are planted.

units.source_text: 太吉郎回到她们两人身边，“倘使能用竹子支撑起来就好了，可是……

en.t: Taikichiro returned to the two women and said, "It would be good if they could be supported with bamboo, but...

units.source_text: 下雨天，过往的人可能会被胡枝子叶弄湿，不好走铺石路哩。”

en.t: On rainy days, passersby might get wet from the bush clover leaves, and the stone path would be hard to walk on."
